cohort: 1240 infants diagnosed with RDS from 26 Neonatal Intensive Care Units in China
finding: The study found that causes of RD differ between late-preterm/full-term infants and early-preterm infants, suggesting an overuse of RDS diagnosis and SRT in the former group.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was closely related to RDS severity in late-preterm/full-term infants.
gest_age: Early preterm, late preterm, full term
